These are safe type-only changes that improve type consistency without altering security behavior. ## Summary I reviewed the diff for `src/requests/_types.py`, `src/requests/models.py`, and `src/requests/sessions.py`. The changes are limited to updating type aliases and type hints for HTTP headers from `Mapping`/`CaseInsensitiveDict` unions to a unified `MutableMapping`-based `HeadersType`. There are no new code paths, no changes to how user input is processed, no hardcoded secrets, no weak cryptography, no unsafe deserialization, and no authentication/authorization logic modifications.
